tools.name: search-documents
tools.description: Find Studocu documents such as lecture notes and summaries. Pass topic keywords as query. Prefer numeric course_id from search-courses; it overrides course and institution. Results with match_type: semantic are closest matches, not exact keyword hits, and may be only loosely related.

tools.name: search-institutions
tools.description: Find a school (university or high school) on Studocu by name, to get its id for search-courses. Show the user the name, type, and country, not the id. If several results are plausible, ask the user to pick.

tools.name: search-courses
tools.description: Find a course on Studocu by name or code, to get its course_id for search-documents, get-course-syllabus, or get-course-mastery. Pass institution_id from search-institutions when you know the school. Show the user the name, code, and school, not the id. If several results are plausible, ask the user

tools.name: get-course-syllabus
tools.description: Return Studocu's generated outline for a course as markdown. If none exists yet, the call returns an error; try again in a few minutes.

tools.name: agent-os-session
tools.description: Show who the current Studocu sign-in belongs to: authenticated, subject, clientId, and scopes. Use only to check that login worked.

tools.name: read-artifact
tools.description: Read a project source or creation by its studocu:// id (from get-project-state, add-document-sources, write-artifact, or request-creation). File and image sources also return the image when a viewable copy, or an original upload under 5 MB, exists.

tools.name: read-detached-document
tools.description: Read the text of a Studocu document by its search-documents id, without adding it to a project.

tools.name: get-context
tools.description: Load the learner's profile, followed courses, and projects. Use get-project-state for what is inside a project. Per-topic practice scores are included only when one course is in scope; otherwise use get-course-mastery.

tools.name: get-project-state
tools.description: List the project sources and creations inside one or more projects. A creation may include external_id (a quiz id or mock-exam id) to match a request-creation result that is still being saved.

tools.name: get-course-mastery
tools.description: Return the learner's practice scores (0-100) for the topics they have practised in one course. An empty list means no practice yet.

tools.name: write-artifact
tools.description: Save a quiz, mock exam, note, or flashcard set you have already written into a project. To have Studocu generate a quiz or mock exam instead, use request-creation.

tools.name: add-document-sources
tools.description: Attach up to 10 Studocu documents from search-documents to a project as project sources. Returns the added sources with their studocu:// ids; compare with document_ids if some are missing.

tools.name: create-project
tools.description: Create a new project. Every field is optional. Returns project_id for add-document-sources, write-artifact, and request-creation.

tools.name: update-project
tools.description: Change the name, icon, or linked course of an existing project. Pass course_id null to unlink the course.

tools.name: request-creation
tools.description: Ask Studocu to generate a quiz or mock exam from 1 to 10 project sources. Can take about 3 minutes. If status is creating or outcome_unknown, check get-project-state before calling again.

tools.name: read-memory
tools.description: Read memories saved for this signed-in learner: one per scope and kind.

tools.name: write-memory
tools.description: Save one memory (a preference or project fact) for this learner. Writing the same kind again replaces it.

tools.name: delete-memory
tools.description: Delete one saved memory for this learner, chosen by project_id and kind.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "request-creation" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
